text.card: A star about 90 parsecs away, 3.4 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.4 solar radii and 2.85 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,006 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Rho Pegasi
quotes.card: Rho Pegasi, Latinized from ρ Pegasi, also named Leidian, is a star in the northern constellation of Pegasus, near the southern constellation boundary with Pisces.
quotes.introduction: This is a probable astrometric binary system, as determined by changes to the proper motion of the visible component.
